about: The steps of connecting a device from away, and why one can fail. One list for the server and every app: WittyMediaClient keeps a copy in shared/data/connect-steps.json (shared/scripts/sync-connect-steps.mjs). Codes never change meaning; add new ones at the end of their step. `match` is lower-case text found in an error or a reason, tried in order, first code wins. `cases` are what the server and every app must answer, each tested against them. While connecting, an app shows each step's `doing` for the step it is on, and `slow.say` once it has taken `slow.after` seconds.

steps.title: Code or link read
steps.failed: The code or link couldn't be read

steps.title: Encrypted connection made
steps.failed: No encrypted connection could be made
steps.doing: Looking for a way to reach your server…

slow.say: This can take up to a minute the first time from away.

codes.say: This link isn't a whole invite.
codes.next: Ask for a new invite, and open it straight from the message instead of copying part of it.

match: isn't a code a device shows
codes.say: That isn't a code this app shows.
codes.next: Type the eight letters and digits exactly as the screen shows them.

codes.say: This device has no connection key.
codes.next: Close the app and open it again. If it happens again, reinstall it.

codes.say: This copy of the app can't connect from away.
codes.next: Install the app from the WittyMediaServer website or your app store.

codes.say: This device isn't online.
codes.next: Check Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again.

codes.say: Your server's address book is off, so it can't be found by a code.
codes.next: Connect with an invite link instead, or turn the address book on in the server's Remote access settings.

codes.say: Your relay is full right now.
codes.next: Try again in a few minutes, or raise the relay's limits.

codes.say: Your relay refused your server.
codes.next: On the server, open Remote access and check the relay's address and key.

codes.say: Your relay couldn't be reached.
codes.next: Check the relay is running, then run Check connection on the server.

match: couldn't be reached at any of its addresses
codes.say: Your server wasn't found.
codes.next: Check the server is on and peer-to-peer connections are on in Remote access. If you only just turned them on, wait two minutes and try again.

match: no server took the code in time
codes.say: Your server didn't answer in time.
codes.next: Check the server is on, then try again. If it keeps happening, run Check connection on the server.

codes.say: Your server was found, but no direct connection could be made through both routers, and no relay could carry it.
codes.next: Try again on another network, such as mobile data, or add a relay of your own in the server's Remote access settings.

codes.say: Your server was found, but a usable connection took too long to set up.
codes.next: Try again. If it keeps happening, add a relay of your own in the server's Remote access settings.

codes.say: Your server was found, but only through a public relay, which can introduce a device but can't carry the connection.
codes.next: On the server, open its peer-to-peer port to the internet (with Docker, publish it for UDP and TCP), turn on UPnP in your router, or add a relay of your own in Remote access.

codes.say: Something answered, but it isn't your server.
codes.next: Ask for a new invite. Don't sign in to a server you don't know.

codes.say: The encrypted connection couldn't be set up.
codes.next: Update the app and the server to the same release, then try again.

codes.say: Peer-to-peer connections are off on your server.
codes.next: Turn them on in the server's Remote access settings, then send a new invite.

codes.say: There were too many tries.
codes.next: Wait a minute, then try again.

codes.say: This invite has run out.
codes.next: Ask for a new invite.

codes.say: This invite was already used.
codes.next: Each invite connects one device. Ask for a new one.

codes.say: Your server isn't taking invites right now.
codes.next: Turn on peer-to-peer connections in the server's Remote access settings, then send a new invite.

codes.say: Your server doesn't have this device on its list of paired devices.
codes.next: Connect this device again with a new invite. Only paired devices can connect.

codes.say: The server couldn't prove it is the one that sent the invite.
codes.next: Don't continue. Ask the server's owner for a new invite.

match: isn't an invite this server understands
isn't a code this server understands
codes.say: Your server didn't accept this invite or code.
codes.next: Ask for a new invite or code, and use it once.

codes.say: Your server was reached, but it didn't sign this device in.
codes.next: Sign in with your name and password, or ask for a new invite.

codes.say: Something went wrong.
codes.next: Copy the details and send them to whoever runs the server.

cases.text: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
reached only through a public relay that can't carry it
this device has no connection key
the server wasn't found in the public address book: context deadline exceeded
the server didn't answer in time
no server took the code in time
the server was found, but a direct connection through both routers couldn't be made, and no community relay is available to carry it
the server refused the connection (is this device still on its list?): stream reset
the relay couldn't be reached: connection refused
joining by a code needs the address book, which is turned off on this server
dial tcp: lookup example: no such host
